correctness.rationale: The exact maxima/minima probabilities give c_i=K_n(P_i)-K_n(P_{i-1}), sum c_i=0, and R_n=sum p_i z_i(x_i-mu). Weighted Cauchy--Schwarz yields C_n(p)^2=sum c_i^2/p_i, with equality iff x_i=a+b z_i. K_n''=n(n-1)[u^(n-2)+(1-u)^(n-2)]>0 ensures consecutive cell-average z_i strictly increase, so equality is admissible iff b>0. For K_n'=n[u^(n-1)-(1-u)^(n-1)], beta-integral yields B_n^2; the orthogonal cell-average identity gives B_n^2-C_n(p)^2=sum int_{I_i}(K_n'-z_i)^2>0 for every positive cell. Independently tested 24 exact rational profile/sample-size cases, the exact polynomials, score ordering and norm deficit. Finite checks corroborate, not prove, the all-profile statement. m must be >=2 for a nondegenerate law; n>=3.
